verdict.rationale: The evidence shows saved tasks that the user starts manually or invokes through Siri, Shortcuts, widgets or Control Center. Nothing documents the product's own rule engine for triggering actions automatically on events. Any event-based automation would come from the host platform's Shortcuts, which earns no credit, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Control Center can run saved tasks.
